record.description_evidence:
Lingvist is the language learning app built by scientists and language experts that teaches vocabulary better than anyone else in the world. The depth of our AI-powered courses combined with the latest research in machine learning gets you using a language with high proficiency, fast. 

GET LEVEL PLACED FOR FREE - TRY LINGVIST

LEARN 16 LANGUAGES: English, Spanish, German, French, Swedish, Danish, Dutch, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Norwegian, Latin American Spanish, Estonian, Polish, Japanese, Korean and Russian.

=====

WHY LINGVIST?

FOLLOW CONVERSATIONS QUICKLY
Learn the vocabulary that appears most often in a language first, allowing you to accelerate your learning.

READ, WRITE, SPEAK, AND LISTEN
Perfect your pronunciation using sophisticated speech recognition technology or type your answers. Every sentence has audio to ensure you hone your listening skills.

FOR SERIOUS LEARNERS
Your learning efficiency is our focus. Enjoy a clean UI with no advertising, no unnecessary clicks, and no distractions.

REMEMBER A LANGUAGE FOREVER
Using scientifically proven spaced repetition methodology, the vocabulary gets fixed in your long-term memory over time. 

LEARN GRAMMAR IN CONTEXT OR AS A FOCUS
Acquire grammar passively like a native with our bite-sized sentences, or practice conjugating French verbs in our French course.

SPECIALIST VOCABULARY FOR YOU
Submit your own words, images, or text and Lingvist will automatically gather vocabulary related to the theme for you to learn. Whether it’s Harry Potter in German or Spanish colors, you can learn the words most important to you. Our AI works intelligently to provide appropriate context for vocabulary.

MOTIVATIONAL STATISTICS
Packed with data on your learning progress, you’ll be able to chart your path to success.

A MUST-HAVE TOOL IN YOUR BAG
Do you live in your target country, use a tutor or language school, or even read books, listen to podcasts, or watch content in your target language? Lingvist works best when used in parallel with other learning methods. It’s the difference between passing your test or acing it. Lingvist is the perfect complement to learn faster and boost your vocabulary.

LEARN BY DOING
Getting it wrong is one of the fastest ways to learn, and your brain will start to remember very quickly.

PERSONALIZED SETTINGS
Every learner is different. Personalize your learning to suit you, with various settings allowing you to learn with extra slow speech, strict diacritics, and even grammar tables.

PERSONALIZED LEARNING PLAN
We'll serve you new words that are most relevant to you. As we measure your memory curves, we ask you to repeat words at the optimal time – just before you forget them. This way, you'll always know what to learn next.

LANGUAGE LEARNING MADE EASY
Whether you are planning on spending this summer in Italy and need to learn Italian, or your next adventure is taking up a course in Germany and you need an app to learn German, or you're heading to Korea and you need to learn Korean, we have you covered. Our language learning techniques will help you to get fluent in over 16 languages.

=====

SUBSCRIPTION
You will need a subscription in order to get access to the full learning materials for all languages we offer. Each subscription will be automatically renewed unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current payment period. When a subscription is canceled, access to the app's courses and features will expire at the end of the current payment period.

LingQ is a language learning app that lets you grow your vocabulary and improve comprehension through meaningful exposure to the language with real content. 

Follow your interests and enjoy an immersive learning experience in over 50 languages. Learn Spanish, English, Japanese, Korean, Italian, German, Portuguese, French, Chinese, Arabic, and other languages.

◆ Massive Content Library: Thousands of lessons from podcasts, books, interviews, videos, articles, and more — all with matching text for easy listening and reading.

◆ Learn Anytime, Anywhere: Study offline and sync your progress automatically. Learn whenever you want.

• AI Audio Transcription: Turn podcasts and audiobooks into interactive lessons.
• AI Voices: Make your lessons, reviews and chats more immersive with natural sounding text-to-speech voices.
• Advanced Chatbot: Get detailed tutor responses and real-time web search with our advanced Lynx AI Chatbot.

• Mini Stories that build a strong foundation at any level;
• Grammar guides with clear, accessible explanations;
• Audio playlists for hands-free listening;
• Karaoke Mode to follow the text while listening;

• Writing Exchange for real corrections from native speakers;
• Tutoring sessions tailored to your goals;
• Community forum for questions, guidance, and motivation;
• Challenges that help you stay consistent and build strong habits;

Built by Language Learners
LingQ was co-founded by Steve Kaufmann, a polyglot who learned more than 20 languages using this same natural approach.

Learn Multiple Languages
LingQ supports more than 50 languages, including Spanish, English, Japanese, Korean, Italian, German, Portuguese, French, Chinese, Arabic and more.

Get LingQ Premium and Accelerate Your Learning
• Unlimited vocabulary lookup and SRS review;
• Comprehensive word tracking to boost your progress;
• Unlimited content imports;

Start learning from real content. 
Download LingQ and begin today.

record.description_evidence:
● Key Features

1. Personalized Learning That Gets You
Tell us which language you want to learn, why you’re learning it, and what you’d like to talk about. We create a learning roadmap based on your goals, interests, and current level. Learn step by step with topics you enjoy and expressions you’ll actually use.

2. Speak Comfortably with an AI Tutor
Practice the things you’ve hesitated to say for fear of making mistakes. Through everyday conversations and roleplay scenarios, put the expressions you already know into practice with an AI tutor.

3. Explore Different Ways to Practice Words and Sentences
Learn vocabulary, take quizzes, and practice listening to and saying sentences. Review what you’ve learned or choose an area you’d like to work on, so you can keep focusing on what you need.

4. See Your Progress Add Up
Keep track of your study time, words learned, and sentences spoken. See how your daily practice adds up as you build a learning routine that works for you.

● Perfect for You If:
- You’ve studied a language but still feel stuck when it’s time to speak.
- You want to learn phrases you’ll use while traveling or in everyday life.
- You’ve been putting off learning because you don’t know where to start.
- You want to practice speaking on your own without worrying about mistakes.

Go beyond memorized answers.
Say what you really want to say.

record.name: Talko: Learn English with AI
record.offering: Education app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Travou? Ficou sem palavras? Não sabe o que dizer?
Você acabou de chegar a um novo país, e a única coisa que consegue dizer ao pedir comida é: "This." Tentar recuperar seu depósito de garantia te deixa completamente perdido. E, durante uma entrevista de emprego... dá um branco.

Não se preocupe. O Talko é seu parceiro de conversas com IA, divertido e amigável. Sem exercícios de gramática nem livros didáticos intermináveis, apenas conversas realistas baseadas em situações do dia a dia. Pratique quando e onde quiser, e ganhe a confiança para falar inglês de forma natural.

Conversas da vida real para preparar você para o mundo real
O Talko foca nas situações do dia a dia que estudantes internacionais, viajantes e recém-chegados a um novo país enfrentam com mais frequência. Conclua uma lição e coloque em prática o que aprendeu imediatamente.

Alugar um apartamento
"Is the security deposit refundable?" "O depósito de garantia é reembolsável?"
Saiba exatamente quais perguntas fazer e evite mal-entendidos que podem sair caro.

Ir ao médico
"It hurts right here, and I've been feeling nauseous." "Dói bem aqui e tenho sentido enjoos."
Quando se trata da sua saúde, conseguir se expressar claramente faz toda diferença.

Pedir em um restaurante
"No pickles, extra sauce, please." "Sem picles, molho extra, por favor."
Vá além de apenas apontar para o cardápio ou dizer "Combo #1".

Conversar com um policial
"I'm sorry—I didn't realize parking wasn't allowed here." "Desculpe, eu não sabia que era proibido estacionar aqui."
Mantenha a calma e se comunique com confiança em situações inesperadas.

Uma IA que parece conversar com um amigo
O Talko não é apenas mais um chatbot. Seu companheiro de IA tem personalidade e um jeito próprio de conversar, tornando cada conversa envolvente e surpreendentemente natural.
"Hey, could I borrow your Wi-Fi password? My phone's about to die." "Ei, você pode me passar a senha do Wi-Fi? Meu celular está quase sem bateria."

Simulações imersivas
Pratique diferentes formas de falar, entenda nuances culturais e aprenda as expressões que os falantes nativos realmente usam.

Feedback instantâneo
Cometeu um erro? O Talko corrige você na hora, de forma natural, para ajudar a melhorar sem interromper a conversa nem causar constrangimento.

Desenvolvido por especialistas. Feito para gerar progresso de verdade.
Aprender deve ser divertido, mas também precisa trazer resultados. O programa do Talko foi desenvolvido com especialistas em ensino de idiomas de universidades de referência, incluindo Harvard. Ao combinar pesquisas comprovadas sobre aquisição de idiomas com conversas reais e envolventes, o Talko ajuda você a desenvolver habilidades naturais de conversação sem parecer que está estudando.

Seus primeiros 30 dias com o Talko
Dia 1: Conclua sua primeira conversa da vida real e descubra que falar inglês é mais fácil do que você imaginava.
Dia 7: Lide com situações do dia a dia com confiança, desde pedir um café até conversar com seus vizinhos.
Dia 30: Aproveite conversas naturais e espontâneas, e repare: "Espera... eu realmente consigo manter uma conversa em inglês."

Pare de decorar. Comece a falar.
Baixe o Talko hoje e faça do inglês falado algo natural no seu dia a dia.

Principais recursos
• Simulações da vida real: Pratique conversas realistas que você realmente vai usar.
• Coach de pronúncia com IA: Melhore sua pronúncia com feedbacks instantâneos.
• Inglês para o dia a dia: Aprenda expressões naturais em vez de frases de livros didáticos.
• Pratique quando quiser: Fale sem pressão, vergonha ou medo de ser julgado. Seu coach de IA está sempre pronto.

Assinatura
O Talko oferece planos de assinatura semanais e anuais com renovação automática. Você pode desativar a renovação automática a qualquer momento, até 24 horas antes do fim do período de assinatura vigente.

Watch Netflix and YouTube with dual subtitles and learn a language from your favorite shows, directly inside Jolii. Log in to your own Netflix or YouTube account: no browser, no extension, not tethered to a desktop computer, completely mobile. Jolii is an AI-powered language learning app that turns your favorite shows and videos into personalized language lessons.

◆ Watch Your Way: 
Explore Jolii’s video library, paste a YouTube link, or connect your own Netflix account to bring your shows right into Jolii, in split-screen or full-screen mode. Get recommendations based on what you enjoy watching.

◆ AI-Powered Personalization: 

Jolii analyzes your chosen YouTube and Netflix content in real time, crafting custom exercises tailored to your language goals, vocabulary level, and learning style.

◆ Context-Based Learning: 

Unlike traditional methods that isolate words, Jolii focuses on learning within the natural context of YouTube videos, Netflix shows and music. This immersive approach fosters deeper understanding and better retention of vocabulary and grammar.

◆ Speaking Practice Anytime: 

Enhance your fluency and gain confidence in real conversations with Jolii's AI chatbot. Answer questions about the scene, step into a character's shoes (Roleplay), practice pronunciation by echoing native speakers (Shadowing), and get instant feedback on how you did. No pressure, no judgment — just practice.

◆ Improve Pronunciation with Music: 

Analyze song lyrics with Jolii, breaking them down into individual words and phrases. Practice pronunciation with phonetic transcriptions and gain a deeper understanding of the nuances of the language through music.

◆ Learn Multiple Languages with One Subscription: 

Expand your linguistic horizons with Jolii's expanding library, featuring courses in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Chinese, Korean, Japanese — and more on the way. A single Jolii subscription gives you access to every language, no separate purchases needed.

Jolii is perfect for:

√ Anyone tired of repetitive language drills that sound like real speech.
√ Netflix and YouTube binge-watchers who want their screen time to count.
√ Learners who want to speak, not just recognize words, and want real conversation practice built in.
√Anyone who wants a mobile-first watching experience, without downloading a browser extension. 

Stop switching between apps and study tools. Download Jolii and start learning from content you love!

Speak More Confidently In Real-Life Under 10 Days

Scenarios is the conversation-first language app that trains you to talk, not just tap. Powered by advanced AI and informed by research from MIT and the University of Granada on the effectiveness of real-time feedback, Scenarios helps you start speaking English or Spanish in under 10 minutes—no vocabulary drills or picture matching required.

Why Scenarios Works — Grounded in Linguistic Research

Retrieval Practice Meets Procedural Memory
Neuroscience work at the University of Granada (2022) demonstrated that speaking in short, repeated bursts activates procedural memory circuits—the same pathways used for riding a bike—more effectively than passive study. Scenarios’ 1-, 3-, and 5-minute timed conversations exploit this principle, helping new phrases move from conscious recall to automatic use.

Contextual Chunking for Real-Life Transfer
Vocabulary remembered in isolation is forgotten quickly. Nation & Newton (2009) found that words learned inside meaningful chunks (“Could I get a latte, please?”) are retained up to 60 % longer and are more readily transferred to real situations. Every Scenarios dialogue is built around whole-sentence exchanges that mirror daily life, so the phrases stick—and so does your confidence.

Conversation from Day 1
Choose a real-world scenario—ordering coffee, acing a job interview, or meeting new friends—and dive straight into a guided dialogue.

AI Coach with Immediate Feedback
Our language model listens, corrects pronunciation, and suggests richer vocabulary on the spot, reinforcing new words while they’re still fresh in your memory.

Difficulty Levels That Grow with You
Beginner, Intermediate, or Advanced: Scenarios adjusts sentence complexity and speaking speed to keep you challenged but never overwhelmed.

Science-Backed Method
Peer-reviewed studies show that learners who receive personalized, immediate feedback improve fluency 46 % faster than those using traditional classroom methods.

KEY FEATURES
Scenario Library – 45+ practical situations with new dialogues added constantly.
Timed Sessions – Pick 1-, 3-, or 5-minute conversations for quick practice or deeper dives.
Skill Grading – Get a score after each session for vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation, fluency, and comprehension.
Progress Tracking – Watch your daily streaks, XP, and overall improvement in the Stats tab.
Gem Rewards – Earn in-app currency for high scores, streaks, and challenges.
Hands-Free Practice – Keep learning without constant button pushing, just talk as much as you can.

Whether you’re preparing for travel, boosting workplace communication, or just want to chat with confidence, Scenarios puts fluent conversation within reach—one real-life scenario at a time.

Download Scenarios today and become more fluent under 10 days!
